arrivals.name: Richmond International Airport (RIC)
arrivals.note: The closest airport, with nonstop flights from most East Coast hubs.

arrivals.name: Amtrak Staples Mill Road station (RVR)
arrivals.note: Richmond's busiest station. Some trains skip downtown's Main Street Station, so book to Staples Mill.

arrivals.name: Charlottesville Albemarle Airport (CHO)
arrivals.note: A smaller airport to the west.

arrivals.name: Washington Reagan (DCA) or Dulles (IAD)
arrivals.note: More flight choices, but plan for I-95 traffic.

hotels.name: Residence Inn Short Pump at the Notch
hotels.note: The closest hotel to Dover Hall.

hotels.name: Hyatt House Richmond/Short Pump
hotels.note: Walk to Short Pump Town Center's shops and restaurants.

hotels.name: Hilton Richmond Hotel & Spa/Short Pump
hotels.note: Full-service, with a spa and restaurant.

hotels.name: Quirk Hotel
hotels.note: A boutique art hotel in the downtown arts district.

todo.name: Virginia Museum of Fine Arts
todo.text: Free general admission, open every day, with a sculpture garden.

todo.name: Maymont
todo.text: A 100-acre Gilded Age estate with gardens, a mansion, and native wildlife. Free to enter.

todo.name: Lewis Ginter Botanical Garden
todo.text: Spring gardens, likely in full bloom the week of the wedding.

todo.name: Belle Isle and the James River
todo.text: Walk the footbridge to an island in the river, with trails and rocks for sunning. Richmond even has whitewater rafting downtown.

todo.name: Carytown
todo.text: Richmond's "Mile of Style": shops, cafés, and restaurants along Cary Street.

todo.name: Scott's Addition
todo.text: The city's brewery and cidery district, all within a few blocks.

todo.name: Hardywood West Creek
todo.text: A big brewery on 24 acres by Tuckahoe Creek, about 4 miles from Dover Hall.

todo.name: Hollywood Cemetery
todo.text: A peaceful, hilly 19th-century garden cemetery above the James.
